title: Broiled Beef with a Mediterranean Twist
description: A quick and easy dish that brings the flavors of the Mediterranean to a classic broiled beef.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the beef, making sure to coat it evenly.
Sprinkle the corned beef rub over the beef, pressing it onto the meat to adhere.
Place the beef on a broiler pan or a rimmed baking sheet.
Broil the beef for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Sprinkle the chopped rosemary and lemon juice over the top of the beef.
Serve the beef with crumbled feta cheese, if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad for a complete meal.
